stem: Meera's mother packs her tiffin before school so that she has enough energy for her classes and games. Which foods in the tiffin are called energy-giving foods?

options.text: Chapati made from wheat flour and a small amount of ghee
Lemon water and a pinch of salt
Only raw spinach leaves and cucumber slices
Only dal, because proteins are the only energy-giving food

teacher.key_rationale: Carbohydrates (wheat chapati) and fats (ghee) provide energy for performing activities, so A is correct. B provides minerals/hydration, C mainly protective vitamins and roughage, D wrongly claims only proteins give energy.
